articles.summary: Transitioning from an individual developer's certificate to an organization's certificate for an Electron app on macOS can be a tricky process, particularly when it comes to **maintaining a seamless auto-update experience for your users**. In this guide, we'll walk through the steps to ensure a smooth transition between certificates, preventing errors and ensuring your app's designated requirements (DR) are met.
articles.title: How to gracefully switch to a new code signing cert on Mac

articles.summary: In this article, we will guide you through the process of decompiling a production Electron app on Mac or Windows. I've found this useful for debugging issues that only seem to appear in the production app but not in development. It's also a neat trick if you want to look into the source of any Electron Application.
articles.title: Decompile an Electron App: A Step-by-Step Guide
